verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own programmatic, UI-free interfaces. The Python Cloud SDK can query and ingest data without the web app or an agent, and the Admin API can create custom commands. The device agent installs via Docker and is configured through environment variables, so automated scripts can drive the platform headlessly. Nothing shows a CLI, CI-pipeline integration, or non-interactive auth guidance for CI runners, so headless use is only implied through SDK/API access. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless mode, documented CI/CD usage examples, token-based auth for CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
